notes.title: Pocket System Revamped!
notes.notes:
New pocket/socket revamped system! Now you can hold 2 small items under your armpits and 2 big ones behind your shoulders(like it was before). However, now there are no magazines that spawn with the gun, instead you find ammo boxes to gain ammo points, and after grabbing a gun, on the opposite side of the hand that is holding the gun, there will be an ammo pouch showing the amount of rounds that you can summon for that gun. However each round has a cost, the stronger the round, the more expensive it will be. So sometimes it’s better to save your shotgun for a bigger opponent instead of wasting a slug on a goblin. And it’s also possible to spend half a mag of a gun per example, then remove the mag and put it back in the ammo pouch to recover half the ammo points, and then grab a brand new full mag or just switch guns if you wish.

Hey Maze Runners! I'm going to be doing some changes with the socket system, for a few reasons, because it's really bad right now, complicated and difficult to use and because having guns with multiple networked mags can lag the server. Instead I'll try to set something up such as the Nightmare Reaper or Boneworks game. The player will be able to collect pistol, rifle and slugs ammo boxes, and the player will have an UI showing how much on each ammo the player has. And if the player is holding the gun with the right hand, that means that somewhere on his left side he will be able to grab a magazine from a pouch, and if the player has per example a simple 9mm glock and pulls a magazine with 20 rounds, it will cost 20 pistol ammo points, if the player instead has a 357 revolver and pulls a six rounder moonclip, it will cost around 18 pistol ammo points per example, being the cost of each 357 round = 3 pistol ammo points. Or it could be that there will be only be one type of ammo point and each type of bullet will have a certain cost. Will see.

Fixed only server hosts being able to set opponents into attention mode from shooting them from afar, before if the non host would do that, the opponent would simply ignore the damage and not charge into the player. Haven’t been able to test this properly though.

Fixed bug of players changing levels while playing coop and one being stuck and the other going back to Login scene

Fixed some japanese texts being invisible.

Fixed reddot of the glock being stuck inside the pistol.

Fixed new players having issues of inheriting the cloud data from my gameplays from the Editor, some players started already with a character while some players started the game in another language

Improved network ragdoll. The drawback is that the opponent downed position is not gonna be the same for all the players, for one player the opponent might be laying on their back, while for another it may be laying on their stomach, however their general position will be the same, and also they will get up at the same time. The positive is that a opponent won’t be sending 1000 lines of information in less than 2 seconds to other players through the network.

Fixed shotgun pumping everytime a player would snap rotate.

Fixed slug having metal sound when dropped on the ground.

Fixed MRS Sight(the one with a plus sign with a dot in the middle), if you saw it through some angles, the red plus sign would partially disappear.
Made bullet wounds decal longer, because sometimes there would be no bullet wound if you shot opponents.

Removed the internal collisions while standing of all opponents(except the big fat orc with the shield, because his belly would pop out of the shield when he blocked), and made the internal collisions to only turn on while opponent is knocked down. Added grunts noises for attacking, getting hurt and dying. This option can be disabled in the Login Scene through the Gameplay Settings.

Added idle sounds for opponents, such as creepy breathing.




[b]Gameplay changes and improvements[/b]

Made it more difficult for opponents to trip and fall.

Made it easier to pump shotguns.

Decreased the running speed of opponents and removed when they sprint towards you and follow up with an attack. My idea was to force players into fighting opponents, without them cheesing and avoiding fights, however many players were finding the sprint a bit strange, so I removed it. In the future I will find a way for the player to not be able to avoid fights or motivate the player to take the fights.

Added a black box around player while loading, so players cannot see where the Exit Room is spawning.

Added a more smooth and better effect to show when the player is damaged

Hi everyone.


Just wanted to let you know what I was working on today.

So whenever an opponent gets knocked out, each body part position, rotation, velocity and angular velocity gets sent to the non hosts of the server, that’s why if an opponent gets knocked out in a position, all the players in the room will see the same thing. However, that is very network taxing. That information of each body part is being sent every 0.1 seconds, causing a 1000 lines of information being sent from the host to the other players in less than 2 seconds. It's 1000 lines just like the attached image.

That’s why when the non host is fighting multiple opponents at the same time, the non host will start noticing lag, players, items and opponents teleporting a little. So I spent around 8 hours trying to find another solution for this, and I will say that I’m getting close. Just wanted to let you know what I spent my time doing today, not happy that I didn’t finish, but tomorrow I will probably optimise this issue.

notes.notes:
DiscordとSteam Forumに日本語話者のためのチャンネルを作成予定です
	(thank you トーチカ for translating)


Couldn’t add a nice cloud system in the Login Scene because the asset I had wasn’t compatible with VR, thank you either way, DieDae.


[b]Audio changes and bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added cooldown to player vocal grunts.

[*] Fixed when playing multiplayer, one player would hear the other player vocal grunt as it was coming from inside your head.

[*] Didn’t leave an option to disable Mic and Music from the Login scene, fixed that.
[/list]


[b]Gameplay changes and fixes[/b]

[list]

[*] Made reddot smaller to look more realistic, thanks Whosile for noticing.

[*] Disabled player to player collision, because it was causing a lot of accidental bumps into pointy objects.

[*] Added a better bullet impact against opponents, now player can see better the body parts of enemies jump around from the impact.

[*] Did some changes to the ragdoll system, however I’m not happy with it, and will still do some changes.

[*] Fixed only server hosts to set opponents into attention mode from shooting them far away, before if the non host would do that, the opponent would simply ignore the damage and not charge into the player. Haven’t been able to test this properly though.
[/list]



[b]Visual bug fix[/b]


[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to see the whole tower and big parts of the clouds from the Login Scene.
[/list]




[b]2 big bugs/issues happening.[/b]


[list]
[*] Players sometimes disconnecting, I believe I may have found the function that’s causing too much information being sent through the network.

[*] When going to the end portal with another player, it causes the next Maze to have a “loading” text in front of the player, causing players to be stuck when trying to move to the end portal afterwards, then forcing players to quit.

[/list]

notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][/b]


Made it easier to pump shotguns.


Decreased the running speed of opponents and removed when they sprint towards you and follow up with an attack. My idea was to force players into fighting opponents, without them cheesing and avoiding fights, however many players were finding the sprint a bit strange, so I removed it. In the future I will find a way for the player to not be able to avoid fights or motivate the player to take the fights.


Made opponents harder to trip (this time I found out how to properly do that).

notes.title: The Maze Early Access is Finally Out!!!
notes.notes:
First of all, I wanna thank my family and everyone that has helped in the release of The Maze!

   I know that the game lacks a few things, such as more Acts, new playable characters, a better RogueLite experience and a higher quality scenario, and that is due to funding. However I hope with the release I will be able to acquire better assets, tools, and hire a 3D model designer to add the new playable characters, and not have to hold back anymore. 

    Most of the ideas to add changes and new things to the game are gonna be through voting. I will send a link to all my newsletters subscribers where they can decide what will be added/changed/spent time working. For example, new Acts, how’s the new Act gonna look like, more optimization, more bug fixing. 

   Scroll to the bottom of the website	to subscribe to the newsletter to receive future links to be able to cast your vote: https://www.initiativevr.com/

    If you see potential in this game and want to help me secure more funds to keep improving on this project, please consider leaving a ✨[i]positive score review[/i] 🎇 in Steam. It helps soooo much us developers. If you cannot purchase the game yet or simply want to help, wishlisting the game is also really good for helping out or telling your friends =)

    You can contact me through gliealonso@initiativevr.com.

    See you all within The Maze!
